candidate.selection_reason: Modified call to pass object parameter -> enables object-specific security validation -> prevents prototype pollution attacks
candidate.source_summary: Object properties come from parsed mathematical expressions via parseObject() in parse.js. Keys are parsed from tokens (symbols or quoted strings), values from parseAssignment().
candidate.sink_summary: The candidate guards against unsafe property access during compilation to JavaScript code. Unsafe properties would throw an error preventing compilation.
candidate.guard_summary: isSafeProperty checks for prototype pollution risks: blocks properties ghosted in prototype chain, inherited from Object/Function prototypes, allows only whitelisted native properties like 'length'.
candidate.risk_pattern: Prevents prototype pollution by validating object property keys during expression compilation, blocking access to dangerous inherited properties like 'constructor', 'toString', etc.
candidate.context_summary: Added security check in object node compilation to prevent prototype pollution attacks by validating property keys against dangerous inherited properties.
unresolved_facts: Specific attack vectors that could exploit unsafe properties in mathematical expressions
Whether user input can directly control object property keys in parsed expressions

target_cwe.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
target_cwe.description: The product receives input from an upstream component that specifies attributes that are to be initialized or updated in an object, but it does not properly control modifications of attributes of the object prototype.
remediation_steps: Implement comprehensive input validation and sanitization
Use whitelisting approach for acceptable inputs
